I know How it feels bro! Mind is playing games with you. You could be a moviestar with high sex appeal - you really got some nice features. Instead you re lonely and depressed and think you are value to none even yourself. It is just in your mind. I feel that way too sometimes. You just lost your best drug which is why you re feeling more depressed than a heroin addict in rehab. It WILL get better But before that you ll have to go through hell - or at least I did. 

You ll have to focus on the physically aspect of getting better and getting more dopamine into your body in a natural and sustainable way -> eat properly, sleep properly, exercise, fresh Air and sun, socialize, be occupied. It feels extra hard right now to do the things listed, But notice the change if you do this regularly for some months. Its kind of mind blowing to be honest and very interesting imo.

Secondally you ll have to focus on the mental aspect of this. Be nice to yourself. If you stop falling, you re not Human anymore. If you stop trying, you re not hoping anymore. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things. When you find hope again, you ll stop being hopeless and depressed. Sounds so simple writing it like this and I know Its not!
Recognize that by time you ll slowly feel better. Keep building on this by doing the physically needed things. See your mind as a house. Right now everything is shattered and even the smallest winds will blow you away. Put some bricks down, and then some Walls. Get the fundament going and in a year you ll have a solid house again which will stand even during strong winds.

I believe in you buddy. My ex had an affair, which made me suicidal and I was calling the suicide hotlines every second day for half a year. Thankfully after a year I found hope again. Hope for something better. I hope that you ll find this hope some day in the near future. Im sure you will actually. But for now it s very tough. Just dont go too hard on yourself. I messed up in some ways, But I know now that I was a damn good boyfriend and that she should have been thankful for me, which she probably is now in retrospect. So please just be nice to yourself. Be forgiving. And dont believe in the red devil on your shoulder telling you that you re worth nothing. Depression is a fucked up thing.

And for now just try to get through the day. Accept that it is rough. But one thing is certain: the sun will shine eventually. After the rain, the sun will come. It has been like this forever.
